_comment: OEM company profiles. Upserted by slug. country_region_code links to regions.json. deployment_status (coarse company-level maturity) uses commercial_status enum verbatim. Company-identity fields (name, country, founded_year, website) are low-risk descriptive facts; a single MANUFACTURER_SITE evidence row per company records where the profile was sourced.

manufacturers.name: Unitree Robotics
manufacturers.description: Chinese manufacturer of consumer-priced legged and humanoid robots sold directly online.
manufacturers.commercial_model: Direct online sale via OEM store (shop.unitree.com).

evidence.note: Company identity and direct-sale model sourced from the official manufacturer site.
